What is the current status of FAA proposed AD docket 2002-CE-05-AD, the proposal to supersede AD 79-10-15 R2 on Cessna 401/402/411 wing spar cap inspections? Is it still open, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. It was withdrawn on 2004-05-18, after the original NPRM (2003-05-09), a comment period extension (2003-07-28), a revised NPRM (2003-09-26), and a reopening of the comment period with a public meeting (2004-01-15). The withdrawal notice also covered the related docket 2002-CE-57-AD. The existing AD 79-10-15 R2 stays in place.

query: Is the 2005 proposal under docket FAA-2005-21679 to require replacing the main rotor blade droop and teeter stops and brackets on Robinson R22 helicopters still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in a notice issued 2021-02-04 (doc 2021-03655). The original proposal was issued 2005-06-20. The withdrawal means the proposed AD will not be adopted as proposed, and no final rule resulted from this docket.

query: Is the FAA's proposed AD for Boeing 787-8/-9/-10 tuning control panel software (docket FAA-2021-0255) still an active proposal, or has it been withdrawn, and which is the most recent version?
gold_status: The records show no withdrawal and no final rule. The proposal appears to still be an open NPRM. Document 2021-07164 appears twice, first issued 2021-03-25 and again 2021-08-31, and the 2021-08-31 entry is the latest. The entries give no comment deadline, and the visible text of the two entries is the same, so the excerpts do not say what changed in the second one.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2019-0576 for Boeing 747-400 and 747-8 series airplanes (dual FMC cold starts) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The FAA issued the NPRM on 2019-07-29 and then withdrew it on 2020-10-07 (doc 2020-23166). The withdrawal is the latest entry, so no final AD will result from this proposal and there is no comment deadline.

query: What is the current status of the proposed AD in docket FAA-2015-1014 for Rolls-Royce Deutschland Tay 650-15 and Tay 651-54 engines (HPT disk life limits)? Is it still open for comment, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM was issued on 2015-05-12 (doc 2015-13743) and proposed reducing cyclic life limits for certain HPT disks. The FAA withdrew it on 2015-11-20 (doc 2015-30010), so there is no open comment period and no final AD is pending from this proposal.

query: What is the current status of the FAA's proposed airworthiness directive for Mitsubishi Heavy Industries MU-2B series airplanes under docket FAA-2016-9139? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA issued the NPRM on 2016-09-08 and then withdrew it in a notice issued 2019-02-19 (doc 2019-03397), so the proposed AD will not be adopted as proposed and no comment deadline applies.
